# Unit test for function count_upper
def test_count_upper():
    # Empty string
    assert count_upper("") == 0
    # All uppercase vowels at even indices
    assert count_upper("AEIOU") == 3  # A(0), I(2), U(4)
    # No vowels at all
    assert count_upper("bcdfg") == 0
    # Lowercase vowels should not count
    assert count_upper("aeiou") == 0
    # Mixed case: only uppercase vowels at even indices count
    assert count_upper("aBCdEf") == 1  # E at index 4
    assert count_upper("abcdefg") == 0
    # Uppercase vowel at odd index should not count
    assert count_upper("aEIOU") == 1  # I(2), U(4); E at index 1 skipped
    # Single characters
    assert count_upper("A") == 1
    assert count_upper("B") == 0
    assert count_upper("a") == 0
    # Uppercase non-vowels should not count
    assert count_upper("BBBEB") == 0
    # Longer mixed string
    assert count_upper("AbEcIdOfU") == 0  # vowels at even indices are lowercase
    assert count_upper("AAAA") == 2  # A(0), A(2)
    # String with digits and symbols
    assert count_upper("A1E2I") == 3  # A(0), E(2), I(4)

def test_count_upper():
    # Basic cases
    assert count_upper("aBCdEf") == 1
    assert count_upper("abcdefg") == 0
    assert count_upper("dBBE") == 0
    assert count_upper("AEIOU") == 3  # A(0), I(2), U(4)
    
    # Empty string
    assert count_upper("") == 0
    
    # Single character
    assert count_upper("A") == 1
    assert count_upper("a") == 0
    assert count_upper("B") == 0
    
    # Vowels at odd indices should not count
    assert count_upper("xAEI") == 1  # A at index 1, E at index 2
    assert count_upper("xE") == 0    # E at index 1 (odd)
    
    # Uppercase vowels only
    assert count_upper("aeiou") == 0  # lowercase vowels don't count
    
    # All uppercase vowels at even indices
    assert count_upper("AEAEAE") == 3  # indices 0, 2, 4
    
    # Consonants only
    assert count_upper("BCDFG") == 0
    
    # 'Y' is not a vowel
    assert count_upper("Y") == 0
    
    # Mixed content with special characters
    assert count_upper("A!B#C$D") == 1  # only A at index 0
    assert count_upper(" A E ") == 2    # A at 0, E at 2
    
    # Long string
    assert count_upper("AEIOU" * 10) == 30  # 3 vowels per 5 chars * 10
    
    # Vowel at last even index
    assert count_upper("xxU") == 1
    assert count_upper("xxUx") == 1  # U at index 2, length 4 means last even index is 2
